notes.title: 【 Update plan 】
notes.content:
Single-player mode will be activated.
 AI Entity(Killer) will be added to the co-op mode.
 Difficulty of finding floppy disks will be balanced.
 Number of computers to be repaired will be increased to 8.
(5 computer repairs are enough to open the exit doors)
 Character Perks System will be activated, and new perk progressions will be added.


These updates will be added via an update shortly.

Note: We are aware that there are no players in the lobby in multiplayer mode. We're sorry for this situation. However, with the upcoming update, we will activate a demo version of the game to reach more players.

notes.title: Flee the Backrooms: Early Access Now Available!
notes.content:
"Flee the Backrooms" is now in Early Access. Our future update plans include:


 Bug fixes
 Single-player Mode
 Addition of character perks.
 Addition of new Backrooms entities and maps.
